outcome: Neurocognitive impairment (primary outcome, >1 SD below normative mean in >=1 Toolbox tests)
cohort: The study included children born with at least one risk factor for neonatal hypoglycemia.
finding: Exposure to neonatal hypoglycemia was not associated with neurocognitive impairment at school-age in at-risk infants, but severe and recurrent episodes were linked to worse visual motion perception and increased emotional-behavioral difficulty.
